## ClientFactory type

The shape shared by the local and remote client factories: an app contract plus locality-specific options yields that app's client, whose type carries the contract's resource table.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ClientFactory<Options> = <Client, Resources extends ResourceTable>(
  app: AppContract<Client, Resources>,
  options: Options
) => Client & ClientBrand<Resources>
```

**References:** [ResourceTable](./contracts.resourcetable.md)<!-- -->, [AppContract](./contracts.appcontract.md)<!-- -->, [ClientBrand](./contracts.clientbrand.md)
